story.title: From the Heart of Palestine, to Every Home
story.body: HATTAH was born from a longing for an unforgettable land, and a sincere wish to keep the details of Palestinian heritage alive in every home and every heart. Every embroidered stitch, every thread, every symbol we bring to you tells a story of patience, beauty, and an identity that has never changed. We work from Turkey with skilled Palestinian hands, to bring you authentic pieces that carry the spirit of the land wherever you are.
